subject: Pilot access extension request while PO issues
messages:
From: Ryan Field <ryan.field@pulsecare.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: PulseCare Procurement <procurement@pulsecare.com>, Elaine Kim <elaine.kim@pulsecare.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Request: keep pilot active while PO issues (procurement delay)

Hi Marcus,

Quick note from procurement — our PO routing has hit a snag with one additional vendor review step and it looks like final sign-off will be delayed about 7–10 business days. We hit this in legal/finance due to a vendor questionnaire that just landed on our docket.

We're in the middle of an active pilot and have a few technical verifications running that would be costly to restart. Would Redwood be able to grant a short extension or temporary credit to keep the pilot environment live until the PO clears? Even a short token allowance or a 72–120 hour extension would preserve the progress we've made.

I've attached a draft of the PO for context (PulseCare_PO_Draft.pdf). If you need a procurement contact to coordinate, that's procurement@pulsecare.com.

Appreciate any help — happy to jump on a quick call if it helps.

Thanks,
Ryan Field
Head of Integrations, PulseCare
ryan.field@pulsecare.com

Attachment: PulseCare_PO_Draft.pdf (pdf, 134 KB)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Ryan Field <ryan.field@pulsecare.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 12:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: keep pilot active while PO issues (procurement delay)

Hi Ryan — thanks for the heads up and for sending the draft PO.

We can absolutely help keep the pilot running while your PO goes through approvals. To move quickly, I can provision a short-term extension and a temporary token credit while we confirm the right approval path internally. Before I finalize, a couple quick Qs:

- Is 10 business days a safe upper bound on the delay?
- Do you have a specific start/stop window you'd prefer for the extension?

If it helps speed things on our end, Vanessa and Ben are cc'd — Vanessa can approve the extension and Ben will coordinate finance if we need to issue a voucher code.

I can offer an interim 7-day runway + 5,000 token credit today while we confirm with ops/finance. If procurement needs more runway we can escalate for a 10–14 day option. Let me know what you'd prefer and I’ll lock it in.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com
